ApplicationArchiveImportSpec.description: A temporary archive target, replaced with an immutable digest at publish.

registry_source_id.description: Internal registry source that receives the image imported from the archive. Only accepted by archive import requests; the published version pins the image through `image_source` with its digest instead.
registry_source_id.title: Registry Source Id

ApplicationArchiveImportSpec.title: ApplicationArchiveImportSpec

name.description: Platform capability: `core_api` (Galene Core API access), `identity_provider` (sign-in with the tenant identity provider; injects `GALENE_TENANT_IDP_*` and `GALENE_TENANT_AUTH_CONFIG_URL`), `object_storage` (a dedicated bucket; injects `APP_OBJECT_STORAGE_*`), `queue` (a Temporal namespace; injects `TEMPORAL_*`) or `memory_db` (a key-value store; injects `APP_MEMORY_DB_URL` and `APP_MEMORY_DB_KEY_PREFIX`). Core provisions a capability only when the installer approves it.
name.title: Name

required.description: Whether installers must approve the capability to install the application.
required.title: Required

target_components.description: Components that receive the capability's variables (unique names); every component when empty.
target_components.title: Target Components

name.description: Component name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit, at most 63 characters; unique in the manifest.
name.title: Name

kind.description: `frontend` or `backend` (both need a `port`) or `worker`; `job` is not supported.

image.description: Container image with registry path and tag or digest, for example `registry.example.com/acme/helpdesk-web:1.4.0`. Exactly one of `image`, `image_source` and `archive_import` must be set.
image.title: Image

image_source.description: Image taken from a configured registry source instead of a literal `image`.

archive_import.description: Image supplied by an archive import; only accepted by archive import requests.

port.description: Container port (1-65535) that receives traffic; required for `frontend` and `backend`.
port.title: Port

persistent_volume.description: Durable volume of the component, kept across upgrades, rollbacks and uninstall.

env_schema.description: Environment variables installers can or must set; names unique within the component.
env_schema.title: Env Schema

depends_on.description: Other components of the manifest this component depends on; unique names, not itself.
depends_on.title: Depends On

ApplicationDatabaseResourceSpec.description: A PostgreSQL database that Core provisions for the application.

name.description: Resource name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique in the manifest.
name.title: Name

extensions.description: PostgreSQL extensions to enable (unique identifiers). Default `["pgcrypto"]`.
extensions.title: Extensions

target_components.description: Components that receive the connection variables (unique names). When empty, the `backend` and `worker` components receive them, or every component when the manifest has none.
target_components.title: Target Components

env_prefix.description: Prefix of the injected `<prefix>_HOST`, `<prefix>_PORT`, `<prefix>_NAME`, `<prefix>_USER` and `<prefix>_PASSWORD` variables. Default `APP_DB`.
env_prefix.title: Env Prefix

url_env.description: Variable that receives the connection URL. Default `DATABASE_URL`.
url_env.title: Url Env

retain_on_uninstall.description: Keep the database when the application is uninstalled. Default true.
retain_on_uninstall.title: Retain On Uninstall

ApplicationDatabaseResourceSpec.title: ApplicationDatabaseResourceSpec

ApplicationEnvVarSpec.description: An environment variable of a component that installers can or must set.

name.description: Variable name: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit; unique within the component. Names generated by Core for capabilities, databases and model roles cannot be supplied by installers.
name.title: Name

required.description: Whether installers must supply a value when there is no `default`.
required.title: Required

sensitive.description: Whether the value is a secret: installers send it as `secret_value`, it is kept in the secret store and never returned. Sensitive variables cannot have a `default`.
sensitive.title: Sensitive

default.description: Value used when the installer supplies none.
default.title: Default

ApplicationEnvVarSpec.title: ApplicationEnvVarSpec

name.description: Resource name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique in the manifest.
name.title: Name

read_only.description: Whether the application only reads the filesystem.
read_only.title: Read Only

ApplicationHealthSpec.description: HTTP health probes of a component.

readiness_path.description: Absolute HTTP path of the readiness probe, without query or fragment.
readiness_path.title: Readiness Path

liveness_path.description: Absolute HTTP path of the liveness probe, without query or fragment.
liveness_path.title: Liveness Path

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe fails (1-20).
failure_threshold.title: Failure Threshold

ApplicationHealthSpec.title: ApplicationHealthSpec

ApplicationImageSourceSpec.description: A registry-source selection retained in an immutable application manifest.

registry_source_id.description: Registry source that holds the image (see `GET /controlplane/registry-sources`).
registry_source_id.title: Registry Source Id

repository.description: External sources: repository path inside the registry, for example `example-apps/helpdesk-web`. Must be omitted for the internal registry, whose tenant repositories are managed by the platform.
repository.title: Repository

reference.description: Image tag or digest, for example `1.4.0` or `sha256:<64 hex digits>`. Images of the internal registry must be referenced by `sha256:` digest.
reference.title: Reference

ApplicationImageSourceSpec.title: ApplicationImageSourceSpec

slug.description: Package slug; it must equal the slug of the package.
slug.title: Slug

requires_core.description: PEP 440 Core version constraint, enforced at publication, install, update and runtime reconciliation.
requires_core.title: Requires Core

ApplicationModelEnvTarget.description: A component variable that receives the model selected for a role.

name.description: Variable declared in that component's `env_schema`, not sensitive and without a default; it receives the selected `provider:model` id.
name.title: Name

ApplicationModelEnvTarget.title: ApplicationModelEnvTarget

role.description: Role name, unique in the manifest: a lowercase letter followed by up to 62 lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`.
role.title: Role

slot.description: `llm` for chat, `embedding` for vectors, or `stt` for transcription.
slot.title: Slot

capabilities.description: Model capabilities the role needs, unique; they must include the slot's capability (`chat`, `embedding` or `transcription`), which is also the default.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

input_modalities.description: Input modalities the model must accept, unique; stt defaults to audio, other slots default to text.
input_modalities.title: Input Modalities

env.description: Component variables that receive the selected model id.
env.title: Env

name.description: Permission key: dot-separated lowercase segments of letters, digits, `_` and `-`, each starting with a letter, for example `tickets.assign`. `access` and names starting with `application.` are reserved. Tenant administrators bind it to tenant roles; the application enforces it.
name.title: Name

description.description: Description shown to tenant administrators (at most 500 characters).
description.title: Description

ApplicationPersistentVolumeSpec.description:
One component-local durable volume.

Runtime adapters retain this claim across application upgrades, rollbacks,
and uninstall. Storage-class selection is intentionally platform-owned.

size.description: Volume size in Kubernetes notation, for example `10Gi`.
size.title: Size

mount_path.description: Absolute mount path inside the container; `/` is not allowed.
mount_path.title: Mount Path

storage_class.description: Optional storage class name (a DNS label).
storage_class.title: Storage Class

ApplicationPersistentVolumeSpec.title: ApplicationPersistentVolumeSpec

ApplicationResourceRequirement.description: Logical tenant resource requested by a package; no tenant identifiers or secrets.

kind.description: Kind of tenant resource to bind.
kind.title: Kind

required.description: Whether installation requires this resource binding.
required.title: Required

ApplicationResourceRequirement.title: ApplicationResourceRequirement

cpu.description: CPU quantity in Kubernetes notation, for example `500m`.
cpu.title: Cpu

memory.description: Memory quantity in Kubernetes notation, for example `512Mi`.
memory.title: Memory

ApplicationRouteSpec.description: A component reachable through a hostname binding.

component.description: Component the route targets; it must be declared in `components`.
component.title: Component

host_required.description: Whether installers must bind a hostname to this route; the control-plane deployment wizard enforces it. Default true.
host_required.title: Host Required

public.description: Whether the route is meant to be public. Default true.
public.title: Public

ApplicationRouteSpec.title: ApplicationRouteSpec

ApplicationServiceRequirement.description: Service operations the installer must explicitly approve for backend/worker components.

role.description: Unique logical service role to approve.
role.title: Role

operations.description: Unique operations from the selected service catalog.
operations.title: Operations

resource_roles.description: Declared resource roles needed by this service.
resource_roles.title: Resource Roles

mcp_tools.description: Explicit remote MCP tool names approved for invocation, without wildcards.
mcp_tools.title: Mcp Tools

execution_modes.description: Allowed execution modes; user mode additionally requires verified delegation.
execution_modes.title: Execution Modes

target_components.description: Backend/worker components; empty selects all eligible components.
target_components.title: Target Components

ApplicationServiceRequirement.title: ApplicationServiceRequirement

ApplicationSessionExecutionSpec.description: Optional application participant in durable session execution.

component.description: Backend component with a `port` that takes part in session execution. It must declare `ASSISTANT_SESSION_EXECUTION_ASSERTION_KEY` (sensitive) and `ASSISTANT_SESSION_EXECUTION_INSTALLATION_ID` in its `env_schema`; Core provisions both at installation.
component.title: Component

ApplicationSessionExecutionSpec.title: ApplicationSessionExecutionSpec

ApplicationVfsSpec.description: Virtual-filesystem defaults declared by the application.

default_base_path.description: Default sandbox base path: a normalized, non-root absolute path. Default `/workspace`.
default_base_path.title: Default Base Path

changeset_retention_count.description: Maximum number of changesets kept (at least 1).
changeset_retention_count.title: Changeset Retention Count

ApplicationVfsSpec.title: ApplicationVfsSpec

description: Deployment contract of one application version.

components.description: Containers of the application: at least one, with unique names.
components.title: Components

capabilities.description: Platform capabilities the application asks for, unique by name.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

permissions.description: Action permissions of the application, unique by name. Core also creates the `access` permission that controls who sees the application.
permissions.title: Permissions

filesystem_resources.description: Filesystems the application uses, unique by name.
filesystem_resources.title: Filesystem Resources

database_resources.description: PostgreSQL databases Core provisions for the application, unique by name.
database_resources.title: Database Resources

model_requirements.description: AI model roles the application needs, unique by role.
model_requirements.title: Model Requirements

service_requirements.description: Core service roles; installation never grants them automatically.
service_requirements.title: Service Requirements

resource_requirements.description: Logical resource roles bound by the tenant installer.
resource_requirements.title: Resource Requirements

session_execution.description: Component that takes part in durable session execution, if any.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata. The tenant application launcher reads `icon` and `accent_color` from it.
metadata.title: Metadata
